items.difficulty_reason: Reduction to a groupoid presentation where exactness is detected on the cover (Groupoids in Spaces abelian lemma), followed by a scheme-level argument: the etale coverings of the fibre products give jointly surjective flat morphisms g_{i,j} and h_{i,j}; flat pullback of qc modules is exact and a jointly surjective flat family reflects injective/surjective/bijective maps (exactness at stalks), giving the three-way equivalence.
